label: <DEL> delimiter step (weaker for long sequences)
explanation: Reset-gate unit that is active almost only on the <DEL> delimiter step (92% of activation mass on dev). It fires on 56% of delimiter steps. Whether it fires there depends on sequence length: the rate falls as L grows (top activations are at L=3-4, and most of the delimiter steps where it stays silent have L=8-9). It is also stronger when the first original token is i/h/d/v. A smaller share (about 8% of mass) comes from original-phase steps at t>=2, mostly the first occurrence of o, z, q, f or p, often one step before <DEL>. It never fires in the copy phase or at t=0-1. Restricting to L<=6 or to particular first tokens raises precision but loses more recall, so F1 barely changes.
